node.title: Re^3: Error: Can't locate Test/Exception.pm in @INC ...
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
like( $@, qr/Unknown encoding format 'Test'/,

Yes, despite some [id://1153468|long-standing issues with $@], since this code is explicitly checking for a specific value, that should work ok too, without any extra modules. [mod://Test::Fatal] uses [mod://Try::Tiny] internally, which works around some of the issues with $@. Three of my four CPAN modules use [mod://Test::Fatal] extensively for testing with no problems across all of CPAN Testers.
